tiers.name: Easy
items: Equipment for level 57 Jogres

tasks.name: Five a Day
tasks.desc: Pick 5 bananas from the plantation located east of the volcano.
tasks.notes: Pick five bananas from the banana plantation at Musa Point.

tasks.name: I'm Lichen This!
tasks.desc: Use the rope swing to travel to the moss giant island north-west of Karamja.
tasks.notes: Swing to the Moss Giant Island, found north-west of Brimhaven, using the rope swing.

tasks.name: Golden Shores
tasks.desc: Mine some gold from the rocks on the north-west peninsula of Karamja.
tasks.notes: Mine a gold ore from the Karamja north-west mine, found to the north-west of Brimhaven.

tasks.name: Put to Port in Port Sarim
tasks.desc: Travel to Port Sarim via the dock east of Musa Point.
tasks.notes: Travel from Musa Point to Port Sarim. This can be done by talking to the Customs officer, found on the dock east of Musa Point. It costs 30 coins to travel, or nothing if using the ring of charos (a).

tasks.name: Avast Ardougne!
tasks.desc: Travel to Ardougne via the port near Brimhaven.
tasks.notes: Travel from Brimhaven to East Ardougne. This can be done by talking to the Customs officer, found on the dock north of Brimhaven. It costs 30 coins to travel, or nothing if using the ring of charos (a).

tasks.name: Show That You Cairn
tasks.desc: Explore Cairn Island to the west of Karamja.
tasks.notes:
Reach Cairn Isle, found north-west of Shilo Village.
Players must climb the rocks then cross a bridge in order to reach the island. This requires level 15 Agility, though higher Agility levels reduce the chance of failure. The quickest way of reaching Cairn Isle is by using fairy ring CKR and running south-west.

tasks.name: Fruity Catch
tasks.desc: Use the fishing spots north of the banana plantation.
tasks.notes: Catch any fish from the fishing spots at Musa Point. They can be caught using at any spot, and using barehand fishing also counts.

tasks.name: Beachcomber
tasks.desc: Collect 5 seaweed from anywhere on Karamja.
tasks.notes:
Pick up five pieces of seaweed on Karamja.
Seaweed can be found along the coast of Karamja, such as west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Dropping the same piece of seaweed and picking it up again counts as multiple pieces being picked up. You do not even have to find any spawn - you can withdraw 1 seaweed from a bank, drop it anywhere in Karamja, pick it up, repeat 5 times.

tasks.name: TzHaar Wars
tasks.desc: Attempt the TzHaar Fight Pit or Fight Cave.
tasks.notes:
Compete in either the TzHaar Fight Pit or TzHaar Fight Cave. These activities can be found within TzHaar City.
Only competing in one of the activities is required.

tasks.name: It's a Jungle Ogre
tasks.desc: Kill a jogre in the Pothole dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Slay a jogre in the Pothole Dungeon.
As jogres are level 57 and are aggressive, it is advised to take combat gear and food. They are weak to water spells, so Magic is advised.

reward.intro:
Talk to Pirate Jackie the Fruit, who is located at the Brimhaven Agility Arena entrance at the, and icons, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 1,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 30 or higher)
Karamja gloves 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: The boat fare when travelling between Port Sarim and Musa Point, or Ardougne and Brimhaven is reduced to 15 coins
140 pineapples can be claimed per week from Dell Monti

tiers.name: Medium
other: 40 Agility Agility recommended (not required)
items:
Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup items
• Food
• Antipoison
• One-click teleport

3 Opals
• or 3 Jades
• or 3 Red topazes

tasks.name: Just the Ticket
tasks.desc: Claim a ticket from Brimhaven Agility Arena.
tasks.notes:
Obtain an Agility Arena ticket from the Agility Arena in Brimhaven.
A ticket can be claimed by tagging a pillar with a flashing arrow above it. Though it is possible to complete this achievement at any Agility level, level 40 Agility is recommended as this allows the player to cross all obstacles and reduces the likelihood of failing.

tasks.name: Back Cran-door
tasks.desc: Discover the hidden wall in the dungeon below the volcano.
tasks.notes:
Open the hidden door in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.
It can only be opened from the Crandor side initially and as such requires Dragon Slayer to access it. It is located by the lesser demons on the Crandor side and the deadly red spiders on the Karamja side.
Completing this achievement also completes Cran Door's Secret.

tasks.name: Dungeons and Dragons
tasks.desc: Visit the isle of Crandor via the dungeon below the volcano.
tasks.notes:
Travel to Crandor from Karamja via the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.
This can be done by opening the hidden door in the dungeon. It can only be opened from the Crandor side initially and as such requires partial completion of Dragon Slayer to access it. It is located by the lesser demons on the Crandor side and the deadly red spiders on the Karamja side. The players are required to travel all the way north and climb the climbing rope at the end of the dungeon in order to complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Horseless Carriage
tasks.desc: Use Vigroy and Hajedy's cart service.
tasks.notes:
Use the Shilo Village cart system to travel from Shilo Village to Brimhaven or vice versa.
This can be done by paying 10 coins to either Vigroy, found west of the Shilo Village bank, or Hajedy, found in northern Brimhaven.

tasks.name: They Like Me! They Really Like Me!
tasks.desc: Earn 100% favour in the village of Tai Bwo Wannai.
tasks.notes:
Earn 100% favour in Tai Bwo Wannai.
This can be done by completing the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup activity.
Trading in favour for trading sticks is not required to complete this achievement. If the player is already at 100% favour, then favour must be lowered then regained to complete this achievement.

tasks.name: Arachnophagia
tasks.desc: Cook a spider on a stick.
tasks.notes:
Cook a spider on stick.
To cook this, obtain a spider carcass and skewer stick (made from any thatch spar). Use the carcass on the skewer stick to create a raw spider on stick then cook it on a fire.

tasks.name: Romancing the Stone
tasks.desc: Mine a ruby from a gem rock in Shilo Village.
tasks.notes: Mine an uncut ruby from a precious gem rock, found in Shilo Village.

tasks.name: I'm a Lumberjack and I'm Okay
tasks.desc: Cut a log from a teak tree.
tasks.notes: Cut teak logs from a teak tree in Karamja. This can be done in Musa Point or in the south of Musa Point. Special teak logs will also count.

tasks.name: I Sleep All Night and I Work All Day
tasks.desc: Cut a log from a mahogany tree.
tasks.notes: Cut mahogany logs from a mahogany tree in Karamja. This can be done to the south of Cairn Isle. Special mahogany logs will also count.

tasks.name: To Catch a Karambwan
tasks.desc: Catch a karambwan.
tasks.notes:
Catch a raw karambwan.
They can only be caught using a karambwan vessel and require a raw karambwanji as bait.

tasks.name: That's Not a Knife...
tasks.desc: Exchange gems for a machete.
tasks.notes:
Obtain a machete from Safta Doc.
Safta Doc sells jewelled machetes of varying types. In order to buy one, he requires a gout tuber, three uncut gems of the type used for the machete and trading sticks. He charges three cut or uncut opals and 300 trading sticks for an opal machete, three cut or uncut jades and 600 trading sticks for a jade machete, and three cut or uncut red topazes and 1200 trading sticks for a red topaz machete.
Players must be in clean-up mode and have spoken to Murcaily beforehand for the chat option in order for a machete to appear.
Repairing a fence in the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup is required to trade with Safta Doc.

tasks.name: Falling With Style
tasks.desc: Use the gnome glider to travel to Karamja.
tasks.notes:
Travel from the Tree Gnome Stronghold to Karamja via gnome glider.
The gnome glider can be found at the top of the Grand Tree. Simply speak to Captain Errdo and select "Gandius".

tasks.name: Scourge of Scurvy
tasks.desc: Grow a healthy fruit tree in the patch near Brimhaven.
tasks.notes:
Grow any fruit tree in the Farming patch north of Brimhaven.
Plant any fruit tree sapling in the patch and optionally pay Garth to protect the tree. Once it is fully grown, check its health.

tasks.name: Hunters of the Horned Graahk
tasks.desc: Trap a horned graahk.
tasks.notes:
Trap a horned graahk.
They can be found in the Karamja Hunter area, south of Tai Bwo Wannai. Build a trap over the pits, requiring any standard logs, then use a teasing stick to entice a horned graahk to give chase. Jump over the trap, which will cause the graahk to walk into it. However, it may also jump the trap. As such, it is recommended to build at least two traps.

tasks.name: The Roots of All Evil
tasks.desc: Chop the vines to gain deeper access to Brimhaven Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Cut a the vines within Brimhaven Dungeon to gain access to the deeper areas.
875 coins must be paid to Saniboch to gain access to the dungeon. Any hatchet bar the blessed hatchet can be used to cut the vines.

tasks.name: Points of No Return
tasks.desc: Cross the spiky pit using the stepping stones within Brimhaven Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Cross over the stepping stones found near the moss giants in Brimhaven Dungeon.
To access the dungeon, players must pay Saniboch 875 coins. The steps can be found by heading west as far as possible then heading south.

tasks.name: Stairway to Haven
tasks.desc: Climb the stairs within Brimhaven Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Climb the stairs within Brimhaven Dungeon, leading up to the Greater demons.
Players must pay Saniboch 875 coins to gain access to the dungeon.

tasks.name: Thank You, Madam
tasks.desc: Charter the Lady of the Waves from Cairn Isle to Port Khazard.
tasks.notes:
Travel to Port Khazard from Cairn Isle via the Lady of the Waves.
The ship can be found on a dock directly south of Cairn Isle. Buy a ship ticket from Captain Shanks, which costs a random amount between 20-50 coins.

tasks.name: Shipping Out From the Shipyard
tasks.desc: Charter a ship from the shipyard in the far east of Karamja.
tasks.notes:
Charter a ship from the shipyard, found to the far east of Karamja.
The password for the shipyard is Ka-Lu-Min. The Trader Crewmembers can be found at the southern-most dock. If Monkey Madness has been started, then the shipyard portion of the quest must be completed. The cheapest destination is Karamja, which costs 200 coins. This can be reduced to 50 coins by completing Cabin Fever and equipping a ring of charos (a), which reduce the price by 50% individually and 75% when combined.

tasks.name: Flawless Victory
tasks.desc: Become the champion of the Fight Pit.
tasks.notes:
Win at the TzHaar Fight Pit.
The player only needs to be the last person standing. They can ask somebody to join them in the game for an easy kill, however, each player involved needs to attack the other(s) in order for the winning player to register the achievement.

tasks.name: Play Dead, Doggy
tasks.desc: Kill a Ket-Zek in the Fight Cave.
tasks.notes:
Kill a Ket-Zek in the TzHaar Fight Cave.
The Ket-Zek start appearing on wave 31 of the TzHaar Fight Caves. For tactics on completing the Fight Cave, see the strategies for the TzHaar Fight Cave.

tasks.name: I'd Be Kharazi to Eat This
tasks.desc: Eat an oomlie wrap.
tasks.notes:
Eat an oomlie wrap.
The oomlie wrap can be eaten anywhere and does not have to be made to count for the achievement. It can be made by combining raw oomlie with a palm leaf then cooking it, requiring level 50 Cooking.

tasks.name: At One With Nature
tasks.desc: Craft some nature runes.
tasks.notes:
Craft some nature runes.
The runes must be crafted at the nature altar, regardless of whether it is accessed via the ruins in Karamja, the Abyss, or the Great Orb Project.
Runes crafted in Daemonheim will not count.

tasks.name: Drop It Like It's Hot
tasks.desc: Cook a karambwan thoroughly.
other: The following is not required if a cooked karambwan is obtained from a gourmet impling:
tasks.notes:
Cook a raw karambwan.
Players must talk to Tiadeche in Tai Bwo Wannai in order to learn how to properly cook a raw karambwan. Otherwise, they will only cook poison karambwan, which will not work for the achievement.

tasks.name: Deadwing
tasks.desc: Kill a deathwing in the dungeon under the Kharazi Jungle.
tasks.notes:
Kill a deathwing in the Viyeldi caves, located beneath the Kharazi Jungle.
To traverse the cave, be sure to bring a lockpick and a pickaxe (if you do not have them on your toolbelt already). These are required to enter the ancient gate. As the deathwing is level 77 combat, combat gear is advised. As they are weak to arrows, Ranged gear is advised.

tasks.name: Quick As a Shot
tasks.desc: Use the crossbow shortcut south of the volcano.
tasks.notes:
Use the strong tree shortcut from Musa Point to southern Karamja (or vice-versa).
Players will need an iron crossbow or better and a mithril grapple. The shortcut can be found just east of Stiles.

tasks.name: A Palm For Each Finger
tasks.desc: Collect 5 palm leaves.
tasks.notes:
Collect five palm leaves.
They can be obtained by shaking Leafy Palm Trees in the Kharazi Jungle. Dropping a leaf then picking it up again counts as multiple pieces being picked up.

tasks.name: Yes, My Master
tasks.desc: Be assigned a Slayer task in Shilo Village.
tasks.notes:
Obtain a Slayer assignment from Duradel in Shilo Village.
Duradel will only assign tasks to players with a combat level of 100 and level 50 Slayer. If he is unavailable during or after While Guthix Sleeps, Lapalok can be used to complete this achievement instead.

tasks.name: Can Opener
tasks.desc: Kill a metal dragon in Brimhaven Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill a metal dragon in Brimhaven Dungeon.
It is advised to bring good gear and antifire protection. Bronze dragons are the weakest dragons which can be killed for the achievement.

Teleport to the Shilo Village underground mine

items:
Nature talisman

• or omni-talisman/omni-tiara/omni-talisman staff
• or wicked hood (with a nature talisman/omni consumed)

tasks.name: At One Plus Fifty-Five With Nature
tasks.desc: Craft 56 nature runes simultaneously, without using pouches or familiars.
tasks.notes:
Craft at least 56 nature runes simultaneously without using runecrafting pouches or familiars. Though not stated, players cannot bring essence that is stored in any of the ethereal outfits while completing this achievement, but the outfit may be worn as long as it is empty.
The runes must be crafted at the nature altar, regardless of whether it is accessed via the ruins in Karamja, the Abyss, or the Great Orb Project.
Runes crafted in Daemonheim will not count.
The achievement can be completed from 44 Runecrafting by drinking a powerburst of sorcery, dropping it, and obtaining a full backpack of pure essence using a friend, or non-abyssal Beast of Burden to carry the potion. Catalytic anima stones can also be used to complete this achievement from 44 Runecrafting.

tasks.name: The Power of Lava
tasks.desc: Equip a TzHaar fire cape while standing in TzHaar.
tasks.notes:
Equip either a fire cape or TokHaar-Kal within TzHaar City.
The TzHaar Fight Cave or Fight Kiln must be completed in order to earn either of the capes. For tactics, see strategies for TzHaar Fight Cave and strategies for Fight Kiln.

tasks.name: Boxing Clever
tasks.desc: Box-trap a monkey on Karamja.
tasks.notes:
Trap a baby monkey using a box trap.
Bananas are used as bait for baby monkeys. Using a clockwork box trap will not work.

tasks.name: It's a Snap
tasks.desc: Buy a snapdragon from Pirate Jackie the Fruit and create a super restore potion in Brimhaven.
tasks.notes:
Buy a clean snapdragon from Pirate Jackie the Fruit for 10 Agility Arena tickets and create a super restore potion from scratch within Brimhaven.
A clean snapdragon, red spiders' eggs and vial of water are required to make the potion. Red spiders' eggs can be obtained from the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon, or purchased on the Grand Exchange. The snapdragon must be mixed with the vial of water to create a snapdragon potion (unfinished) then used with the red spiders' eggs to finish off the potion, entirely within Brimhaven.

tasks.name: Crunchy Coating
tasks.desc: Cook a shark over a sulphur pit.
tasks.notes:
Cook a raw shark on a sulphur pit, located within TzHaar City.
A bonfire made in the city will also work. Raw great white sharks cannot be used for the achievement.

tasks.name: Walkies!
tasks.desc: Take your chameleon for a walk around Cairn Isle to see its egg-home.
tasks.notes:
Have a chameleon following them while on Cairn Isle.
Either a baby or adult chameleon can be used for the achievement.

tasks.name: Tread Carefully
tasks.desc: Use the stepping stone across the river in Shilo village[sic].
tasks.notes: Cross over the river in Shilo Village by using the stepping stones.

tasks.name: Ten in a Row
tasks.desc: Gain 75+ Slayer points from Lapalok.
tasks.notes:
Earn at least 75 Slayer points from a single task from Lapalok.
Lapalok will replace Duradel as a Slayer Master at Shilo Village during and after While Guthix Sleeps. Lapalok will only reward 75 or more points if the player completes their 10th, 50th, or 100th task with him in a row without resetting at Spria and if Smoking Kills is completed (10th task only). The fastest way to complete this achievement is by doing 1st–9th tasks at a lower slayer master like Jacquelyn and picking up the 10th task from Lapalok.
